title: Tom DeLonge email to John Podesta about General McCasland

tellings.quote: Buried in that email dump is an email from Tom Dong to Podesta. The subject line, General McCassland Dong writes, he mentioned he's a skeptic. He's not. I've been working with him for 4 months.

plain: Among John Podesta's emails, published by WikiLeaks in 2016, is one from the musician Tom DeLonge to Podesta, a senior Democratic political adviser, with the subject line "General McCasland", about the retired Air Force general Neil McCasland. Jesse Michels reads it out himself: DeLonge writes that the general "mentioned he's a skeptic. He's not. I've been working with him for 4 months." Michels raises it because, if true, it would mean a senior general was quietly working with DeLonge on UFOs while publicly claiming doubt.
